# ADR-3025: A03: Dynamic SQL string concat for query family 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

String-built SQL enables classic injection.

## Decision

Data access code SHALL NOT build a dynamic SQL string concat for query family 1 (A03-1).

## Consequences

Parameterized queries or query builders are mandatory.
